parts.content: Work in D:\PropelExp. Implement EP-002 US_018 TASK_001 through TASK_006 only; do not implement frontend TASK_007. Read all six complete task files first. Follow existing frozen strict Pydantic/domain patterns under backend/src/cms_planner and tests. Implement exactly expected files: cms_structure_detector.py, cms_layout.py, deficiency_boundaries.py, deficiency_extraction.py, deficiency_schema.json, deficiency_candidate_validator.py, deficiency_candidate.py, deficiency_policy.py, store_extraction_result.py. Add focused tests at every task Build Commands path. Requirements: deterministic CMS-2567 recognition retaining supported layout; unrecognized stops candidates; recognizable header with zero F-tags remains recognized empty; identify separate F-tag/SOD boundaries across ordered pages including repeated tags and incomplete SOD; closed provider-neutral contract with evidence/confidence/uncertainty and stable identities; incomplete SOD always uncertain/unconfirmed and cannot transition to confirmed; atomic store of recognized layout + candidates, including zero candidates. Integrate with the existing repository conservatively; if CaseAggregate lacks appropriate typed state, prefer a narrowly scoped extraction store/result abstraction in the expected service rather than broad unrelated refactors, but tests must prove no partial writes on rejection. Use standard library + Pydantic only unless pyproject already has another dependency. TDD: add first focused test, run it, implement, rerun. Keep functions <=50 LOC and complexity <=7. Use apply_patch for edits. Mark validation/checklist boxes [x] in only TASK_001..TASK_006 after tests pass. Run all six focused suites together and report files/results. Do not touch frontend, other task files, or unrelated user changes.
